caption: The drawing features a single object, an octagonal soap dish and strainer resting on a flat horizontal surface. The soap dish has a broad, flat rim and angulated walls that taper slightly outward toward the top, forming an overall octagonal shape. The dish is colored in shades of brown and green, with a marbled texture pattern that covers its entire surface, giving it a stone-like appearance. The interior of the dish is depicted with variations of green, while the exterior has more brown and yellowish tones, with lighter streaks and patches creating a mottled effect. The background is a gradient of off-white at the top and a muted brownish surface below the dish. Above the dish, in capitalized serif lettering, the words "SOAP DISH AND STRAINER CIRCA 1849" are printed. The composition is centered, with the soap dish positioned in the middle of the drawing and the text above it.
title: Soap Dish and Strainer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
